# Bundled brand fonts

The Lazarev Cloud design system typography, embedded into the binary at build
time (`smith_ui::register_brand_fonts`) so the UI renders the brand fonts on any
machine without an install step.

| File | Family | Role |
|------|--------|------|
| `Inter.ttf` | Inter (variable) | body / UI text |
| `Poppins-{Regular,Medium,SemiBold}.ttf` | Poppins | display / headings |
| `SplineSansMono.ttf` | Spline Sans Mono (variable) | labels, status, time, code |

All three are licensed under the **SIL Open Font License 1.1** (`OFL.txt`), which
permits bundling and redistribution. Copyright holders:

- Inter — The Inter Project Authors (https://github.com/rsms/inter)
- Poppins — Indian Type Foundry, Jonny Pinhorn
- Spline Sans Mono — Eben Sorkin, Mirko Velimirovic, and the Spline Project Authors

Sourced from the Google Fonts repository (https://github.com/google/fonts).
